Gets a feed's details and its latest ite: 获取订阅源的详细信息及其最新条目，按最新优先。
Gets the latest items from several feeds: 将多个订阅源的最新条目合并为一个列表，按最新优先。
Finds the RSS and Atom feeds a website p: 查找网站发布的 RSS 和 Atom 订阅源。
Link to the feed itself, not the site ho: Link to the feed itself, not the site homepage; Atom works too.
Maximum number of items to return, newes: 要返回的最大条目数，按最新优先（1–100）。默认为 20。
Only return items published after this d: 仅返回在此日期和时间之后发布的条目。没有发布日期的条目将被排除。
Only return items whose title, summary o: 仅返回标题、摘要或内容包含此文本的条目（不区分大小写）。
One feed address per row; a feed that fa: One feed address per row; a feed that fails to load is skipped.
A page on the site, such as its homepage: 站点上的一个页面，例如主页或博客文章。
Runs when a new item is published in an: Runs when a new item is published in an RSS feed.
Runs when a new item is published in any: Runs when a new item is published in any of the feeds you list.
